name: NGC 4291 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 4291, a galaxy with a massive central black hole, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc4291-hubble
story: Astronomers have weighed the black hole at the center of NGC 4291 by tracing how the galaxy's stars move around it.

claims.text: NGC 4291's central black hole mass has been measured from stellar dynamics
